summary: Build practical BESS hazard, electrical-control, and emergency-planning skills. Explore the course outline and suitability for your team.
lede: Battery energy storage safety training helps operators, safety officers, project engineers and emergency planners assess system hazards and prepare for abnormal conditions. Participants practise identifying electrical and operational risks, verifying isolation and interpreting monitoring alarms, then develop thermal-runaway response plans and coordinate emergency roles and contractor controls. The focus is practical operating readiness, not detailed system engineering or advanced fire testing.
audienceIntro: This specialist course is for people who operate, deliver, maintain, or plan emergency response for utility-scale and commercial battery energy storage systems. It focuses on storage-specific electrical and operational risks rather than general occupational health and safety or fire-safety training.
prerequisites: Recommended: working familiarity with electrical, energy-storage, project, safety, or emergency-response operations. No programming is required. Bring relevant site procedures or system information only when your organization permits their use; no specific software or pre-installation is specified.
